intention: A real /settings page with a working theme selector, backed by one account.settings table that is the single home for every per-user preference.
request: Source ticket: MAG-43 — Theme selector - Settings page. It's possible to allow selecting a theme for the entire website, and applying that theme in runtime? Like a Theme selector dropdown? Currently, I think the theme is set in data-theme="graphite" (base.templ), I think the app currently supports halloween, apex and graphite. Let me know your thoughts. If that would be possible, add the theme selector into the settings page (new page that has a label "soon") on the menu

decisions.decision: New account.settings table with typed language+theme columns; accounts.language migrates in and is dropped
decisions.why: Split storage (theme in a new table, language left on accounts) rejected: two homes for preferences makes every future setting ambiguous

decisions.decision: Settings row created at signup in the same transaction; existing rows backfilled by the migration
decisions.why: Reads stay a plain PK lookup with no COALESCE and no missing-row branch

decisions.decision: Theme applies instantly via JS data-theme, no HX-Location reload
decisions.why: Language is server-rendered text and needs a re-render; a theme is CSS-only and does not

decisions.decision: ui.Themes is the single closed vocabulary, enforced by a new make theme-guard wired into make check
decisions.why: Parsing input.css at startup rejected: halloween is not an @import, so the parser needs two shapes and moves errors to run time

decisions.decision: Read caching is out of scope; filed as MAG-47 blocked by MAG-43
decisions.why: LanguageMiddleware's per-request DB read (incl. /static) is a separate blast radius touching middleware and its tests
